pendingSeal.message: Certification of the boundary and topography by a Virginia licensed land surveyor. The plan is complete and delivered; this is the review step that follows. The boundary shown is GIS, compiled rather than surveyed — in testing, county GIS was 4.3 ft off the surveyed line and a front setback flipped from compliant to non-compliant once corrected.
Virginia surveyor-certified boundary and topographic survey (surveyor): GIS parcel geometry is preliminary and may be offset from surveyed boundaries. A permit submission needs certified geometry.
Confirm with DES whether the disturbance requires a Land Disturbing Activity permit.
Check the lot against Chesapeake Bay Preservation Area (RPA) mapping.

Zoning envelope — Front 25 ft from the right-of-way line; reducible to the average of the frontage (not below 15 ft; garage 18 ft) on Zoning Administrator approval of a plat, §3.2.6.A.1(e). Side 10 ft, one may be 8 ft; both together at least 30% of the 60 ft required lot width, §3.2.6.A.2(b). Main building footprint limited to 30% of the lot and 2,520 SF (more with a front porch), §3.2.5.A.
Review and seal by the professionals responsible for each subject. The platform drafts a complete plan; the seal is a human act that follows delivery. Nothing here implies county approval.
